decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 3 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant other than that shown on the approved drawings shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Before [any] [specified plant and/or machinery] is used on the premises, it shall be [enclosed with sound-insulating material] [and] [mounted in a way which will minimise transmission of structure borne sound] in accordance with a scheme to be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The ground floor room marked "staff accommodation" on Drawing No. 12699/02M, and the first and second floor rooms shown astaff accommodation within former Nos 13 and 14 Strand on the Green on drawing no. 126991/3R shall be used as residential staff accommodation only.

Condition : 6 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.
description: Erection of a single storey part flank extension and single storey rear extension incorporating  internal alterations and refurbishment of existing public house
